pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Strikes you make with your deity's favored weapon against a creature with the doomed condition have the death trait, causing the target to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Strikes you make with your deity's favored weapon against a creature with the doomed condition have the death trait, causing the target to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points. When killed in this way, attempts to communicate with it, return it to life, turn it into an undead, or otherwise disturb its afterlife fail unless the effect's counteract rank is higher than half your level when you killed the creature (rounded up), or originates from an artifact or a deity.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Shadow of Death

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Sinking Jaws
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a jaws or fangs unarmed attack
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Like how a constrictor wraps itself around its next meal, your companion tightens its teeth around its constrained prey to squeeze the life out of it.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Like how a constrictor wraps itself around its next meal, your companion tightens its teeth around its constrained prey to squeeze the life out of it. Your companions with a qualifying unarmed attack learn the Sinking Jaws activity.

**Sinking Jaws** ◆

**Requirements** This companion has a creature grabbed or restrained with its jaws or fangs

**Effect** This companion's grabbed or restrained foe takes piercing damage equal to the companion's level plus Strength modifier.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Sinking Jaws

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Slingshot Maneuver
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You spin your lash out for your ally to grab on to, giving them a boost to their movement.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Trigger** A willing ally enters a space within your lash's reach using a move action.

You spin your lash out for your ally to grab on to, giving them a boost to their movement. You move the ally 15 feet into a square of their choice that is within reach of your lash. If the ally has movement remaining, they can continue their movement after completing the Slingshot Maneuver.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Slingshot Maneuver

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Spear of Doom
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: The conditions for your doom have been met, and you brace yourself for a battle that will see you either live to fight another day or die a legend.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** An enemy hit you with an attack dealing the same damage type as your cursed weakness within the last round, and you are Doomed 1 or greater.

The conditions for your doom have been met, and you brace yourself for a battle that will see you either live to fight another day or die a legend. You enter the spear of doom stance. While in this stance, as long as the enemy who triggered your cursed weakness is within your reach, you can Strike them as a reaction whenever they succeed or critically succeed at an attack against you. You gain an additional reaction immediately and at the start of each of your subsequent turns that can only be used to make Reactive Strikes against that opponent, or to make the Strike granted by this stance.

While in spear of doom stance, your cursed weakness is equal to your level instead of half your level.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Spear of Doom

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Spell Swallow
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your ostilli has grown strong enough to completely consume a spell cast at you, granting you the Devour Ambient Magic action.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your ostilli has grown strong enough to completely consume a spell cast at you, granting you the Devour Ambient Magic action.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Spell Swallow

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Spraying Mutation
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your ostilli can launch a multitude of darts at once over a short distance.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your ostilli can launch a multitude of darts at once over a short distance. When you Spit Ambient Magic, you can have it affect all creatures within a 15-foot cone instead of the normal target.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Spraying Mutation

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Springboard
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You use the power of your leg lashing out to spring off your foe and leap toward another, your talon descending in a crescent.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** Your previous action was a successful spinning talon Strike against an adjacent foe.

You use the power of your leg lashing out to spring off your foe and leap toward another, your talon descending in a crescent. You Leap, which doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy you struck. If you land within melee reach of an enemy, you can choose to make a spinning talon Strike against them.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Springboard

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Steal Time
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You reach into another creature's timeline and attempt to alter their flow of time.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You reach into another creature's timeline and attempt to alter their flow of time. Select a creature within 30 feet. That creature attempts a Fortitude saving throw against your chronoskimmer DC. The creature takes the effects of Slow based on the result of its saving throw.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Sweeping Tail
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a tail unarmed attack
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your companion swings its tail powerfully.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your companion swings its tail powerfully. Your companions with a qualifying unarmed attack learn the Sweeping Tail activity.

**Sweeping Tail** ◆◆ This companion makes two tail Strikes against different creatures within its reach, increasing its multiple attack penalty as normal. On a hit, it pushes a target back 5 feet or 10 feet on a critical hit. This is forced movement.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Sweeping Tail

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Tag Team
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your skilled teamwork with your spotter enables you both to assist one another when you falter, using either other's failures as opportunities to strike.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Trigger** You or your spotter misses with a Strike against a creature, and the creature is within the other's melee reach or first range increment.

Your skilled teamwork with your spotter enables you both to assist one another when you falter, using either other's failures as opportunities to strike. If you used Tag Team after your spotter missed the triggering Strike, make a ranged Strike against the same target with a -2 penalty. If you used this reaction after you missed the triggering Strike, your spotter can use their reaction to make a melee or ranged Strike against the same target. Strikes granted by this feat don't count toward your or your spotter's multiple attack penalty and your or your spotter's multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to the granted Strike.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: The Truth As I See It
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your knack for spinning a believable reality from threads of story is so practiced that sometimes even you begin to believe what you're saying.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your knack for spinning a believable reality from threads of story is so practiced that sometimes even you begin to believe what you're saying. When you use Deception to Lie, you can carefully structure your deceits so that each individual statement you make is the truth, from a certain perspective. Once per day when using Deception to Lie, you can roll twice and take the better result. This is a fortune effect.

You don't take a penalty to Deception checks while subject to the ring of truth spell or similar effects. Whenever you are subject to ring of truth or a similar effect, you can attempt a Deception check when you first begin speaking to counteract the spell's effects, with a counteract rank equal to half your level (rounded up); succeeding at this check doesn't end the spell or effect, but it does cause it to indicate that you are speaking the truth, even when you are actually lying.

Effect: The Truth As I See It
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: The Truth As I See It

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Touch of Lunacy
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: In moments of viciousness, your curse can partially infect your prey.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: In moments of viciousness, your curse can partially infect your prey. Whenever you critically succeed with an unarmed attack from the werecreature archetype, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, or become Clumsy 2 until the beginning of your next turn as their bones elongate and form warps. On a critical failure, the target is also Clumsy 1 for one minute as the transformation lingers.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Touch of Lunacy

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Trample Mimicry
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use Trample or have identified a creature with Trample in combat
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You Stride up to double your speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, trampling each creature whose space you enter.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You Stride up to double your speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, trampling each creature whose space you enter. You can attempt to trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample Mimicry. You deal level-based bludgeoning damage to each trampled creature (basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). This damage increases by 1d12 at levels 14 and 18.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Trample Mimicry

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Translocational Adept
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your command over teleportation grows.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your command over teleportation grows. You can cast translocate as an innate 4th-rank occult spell once per day. At 14th level, the spell is heightened to 5th rank. When you cast translocate this way, you can Part the Veil as a free action when you arrive at your destination, even if you wouldn't normally meet its requirements.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Unbelievable Escape
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your ability to narrowly evade danger defies all logic.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your ability to narrowly evade danger defies all logic. You can use Lucky Escape once per hour instead of once per day.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Veil of Bugs
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your swarm is dense, blotting out vision.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your swarm is dense, blotting out vision. You and your allies gain lesser cover when in your swarm's space.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Veil of Bugs

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Vicious Rend
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a claw, fist, pincer, or talon unarmed attack
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your companion sinks its claws and rips.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your companion sinks its claws and rips. Your companions with a qualifying unarmed attack learn the Vicious Rend activity.

**Vicious Rend** ◆◆ Make two claw, fist, pincer, or talon Strikes against the same target, applying the multiple attack penalty as normal. If both Strikes hit, the target takes an additional 1d6 persistent bleed damage. This damage increases to 2d6 if your companion is specialized.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Vicious Rend

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Vindicator's Judgment
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can pronounce judgment on your foes, making them magically susceptible to your attacks.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You can pronounce judgment on your foes, making them magically susceptible to your attacks. You gain the Vindicator's Judgment focus spell.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Vindicator's Judgment

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Wide Overwatch
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Through a variety of perceptive techniques, careful routines, and upgrades to your enhanced visual gear, you have become able to observe and maintain your overwatch at a much greater distance.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Through a variety of perceptive techniques, careful routines, and upgrades to your enhanced visual gear, you have become able to observe and maintain your overwatch at a much greater distance. Increase the size of your overwatch field from 30 feet to 60 feet.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Winter's Embrace
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your eyes are accustomed to the harsh glare of the sun on snow and ice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your eyes are accustomed to the harsh glare of the sun on snow and ice. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against effects that inflict the dazzled condition. Snow doesn't impair your vision; you ignore concealment from snowfall. Your skin becomes cold to the touch, and sometimes frost forms on you. You are protected from severe cold and heat.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Advanced Firearm Familiarity
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Gunslinger Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You have familiarity with advanced firearms, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You have familiarity with advanced firearms, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency. You gain access to all uncommon firearms.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Advanced Firearm Familiarity

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Aerial Flash
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Even creatures who take to the air can't escape you.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Even creatures who take to the air can't escape you. You teleport to any square within 60 feet that's within reach of a creature, then make a melee Strike against that creature. After this Strike, you teleport back to your prior position.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Afterimage
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You leave behind an afterimage of yourself in your previous square.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Trigger** You use an action or cast a spell with the teleportation trait.

You leave behind an afterimage of yourself in your previous square. This afterimage looks like you and can perform simple behaviors to make the deception more plausible but otherwise cannot move or take actions. A creature can distinguish between you and your afterimage easily. Your afterimage automatically fails all checks and DCs and is destroyed if it would take any damage; otherwise, it lasts for 1 minute. Whenever you take the Step action, you can instead teleport to an afterimage instead. If you do, the action gains the teleportation trait, and the afterimage you teleport to is destroyed.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Banshee Cry Display
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've learned how to unleash a sudden and disruptive noisemaker at just the right moment in your display, a technique that can cause a spellcaster to fumble the phrasing of their magic.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You've learned how to unleash a sudden and disruptive noisemaker at just the right moment in your display, a technique that can cause a spellcaster to fumble the phrasing of their magic. You gain the Banshee Cry fireworks display.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Banshee Cry Display

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Battlefield Arcana
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You have learned to safely cast spells even in the heat of battle.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You have learned to safely cast spells even in the heat of battle. If the next action you use is to cast a wizard cantrip, or a wizard spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank wizard spell slot you have, that spell does not trigger reactions that normally trigger due to a spell being cast or someone using an action with the manipulate trait.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Beguiling Aura
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You channel your manipulative magic to subtly give off mental signals that either drive enemies away or draw them closer.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You channel your manipulative magic to subtly give off mental signals that either drive enemies away or draw them closer. You gain a 30-foot aura that lasts for 1 minute. When an enemy within your aura fails a saving throw against one of your innate captivator spells, you can also have them Step in a direction of your choice, though they must remain within your aura. You can't choose to have a creature Step into hazardous terrain, off a ledge, or the like.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Billowing Wings
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with wings
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've trained your winged companions to gather air in their wings, whipping up a concentrated gust of wind at opponents, potentially staggering them.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You've trained your winged companions to gather air in their wings, whipping up a concentrated gust of wind at opponents, potentially staggering them. Your companions with wings gain a gust ranged unarmed attack, which deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage with a range of 30 feet and has the air and propulsive traits. On a critical hit, the target is pushed back 5 feet. This is forced movement.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Billowing Wings

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Buzzing Death Cicadas
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: The inclusion of these death cicadas grants your swarm a fly Speed of 20 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: The inclusion of these death cicadas grants your swarm a fly Speed of 20 feet. You also gain the Death Drone action.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Buzzing Death Cicadas

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Call the Hunt
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You instruct your allies on how best to defeat your prey.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You are observing your hunted prey.

You instruct your allies on how best to defeat your prey. Until the start of your next turn, whenever your hunted prey is within reach of you and at least one of your allies, it is off-guard to all melee attacks. If you are sanctified, the unarmed attacks and weapon Strikes of you and all your allies gain the benefits of your sanctification against your hunted prey.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Call the Hunt

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Cellular Reconstruction
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your ostilli takes control of your nervous system and kicks your cellular functions into overdrive when you're about to die.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your ostilli takes control of your nervous system and kicks your cellular functions into overdrive when you're about to die. You regain Hit Points equal to your level. For the next 2 rounds, at the start of your turn, you regain Hit Points equal to half your level. The first time you regain Hit Points at the start of your turn, you reduce your wounded condition by 1.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Cellular Reconstruction

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Claw and Talon Flow
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You fluidly shift between your two stances.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You're in either claw stance or talon stance.

You fluidly shift between your two stances. You use the unarmed attack associated with your current clawdancer stance, then switch into the other stance (if you're in claw stance, make a frenzied claw Strike and then shift to talon stance, or vice versa).
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Claw and Talon Flow

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Collapse Wall
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You detonate the required bombs in order to bring a wall down on a creature.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Trigger** A creature moves into the bombs' splash area.

**Requirements** You're within 30 feet of an area where you rigged bombs on a wall, cliff face, or similar vertical surface with Set Explosives or Demolition Charge.

You detonate the required bombs in order to bring a wall down on a creature. If your bombs deal enough damage to reduce the wall's Hit Points below its Broken Threshold, the wall partially collapses on the creature. The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to the damage dealt to the wall (basic Reflex save; the DC for this save is equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). On a failure, they must spend an Interact action to dig themselves out of the collapse, and on a critical failure, they must spend 2 Interact actions to do so.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Combat Premonition
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: By narrowing your sense of the future, you can improve that of your allies.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
By narrowing your sense of the future, you can improve that of your allies. When you roll initiative, instead of stabilizing or destabilizing your own timestream, you can grant your allies a flash of insight into their future. Choose two allies. Those allies roll their initiative roll twice and take the better result; this is a fortune effect. You roll your initiative roll twice and take the worse result; this is a misfortune effect. The two effects are tied together: if you would avoid the misfortune effect for any reason, or if any of your allies would negate their fortune effect, your Combat Premonition does nothing.

Effect: Combat Premonition

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Construct Dynamo
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic, and your dynamo Strikes become magical.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic, and your dynamo Strikes become magical.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Coordinated Tactics
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You and your follower fight in tandem.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You and your follower fight in tandem. Whenever you and your active follower are adjacent to the same foe, you are both flanking that foe with each other, regardless of your actual positions.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Danse Macabre
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your horde can drag unwilling victims along with it as it shambles forward.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Requirements** Your horde is raised.

Your horde can drag unwilling victims along with it as it shambles forward. Your horde Strides up to its Speed and can move through the spaces of Large and smaller creatures, but it must end its movement in an unoccupied space. Each creature whose space it moves through is subjected to the horde's Mobbing Assault, attempting a basic Reflex save as usual. A creature who fails the saving throw is also Repositioned to an unoccupied square of your choice adjacent to the horde's final position. You can't move the creature into or through obstacles.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Drive-By Attack
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can smoothly line up an attack without disrupting your control.You Drive, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Drive-By Attack.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You are piloting a vehicle.

You can smoothly line up an attack without disrupting your control.You Drive, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Drive-By Attack. At any point during your vehicle's movement, you Strike.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Eagle Eye
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your practice with crossbows and firearms has sharpened your attention to detail.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your practice with crossbows and firearms has sharpened your attention to detail. You become a master in Perception.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Eagle Eyes
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You and your spotter are adept at watching out for one another.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You and your spotter are adept at watching out for one another. As long as you can see or hear each other, neither of you is off-guard to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures of your level or lower, or to creatures of your level or lower using a surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Escape Timeline
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You step outside of the flow of time momentarily, allowing you to avoid dangers.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** Your turn begins.

You step outside of the flow of time momentarily, allowing you to avoid dangers. Your physical form stops existing momentarily, and you can't be targeted or affected until the start of your next turn—you simply don't exist at that moment in time. Your turn ends immediately, advancing 1 round for all timed durations and effects, such as conditions and afflictions. You still attempt saving throws, flat checks, or any other checks at the end of your turn as normal, but you don't take any damage due to these checks (though you take any non-damaging effects as normal). At the start of your next turn, you reenter the flow of time and reappear in the same space where you left time last round. If the space isn't clear, you arrive in the nearest open space.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expert Animist Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Basic Animist Spellcasting; master in Religion
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Expert Animist Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expert Beast Gunner Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Basic Beast Gunner Spellcasting or Basic Wizard Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've learned the deeper secrets of beast guns, making you an expert in the magic they grant you.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You've learned the deeper secrets of beast guns, making you an expert in the magic they grant you. You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Expert Beast Gunner Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expert Combat Eidolon
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your eidolon advances their capabilities in combat.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your eidolon advances their capabilities in combat. Your eidolon becomes an expert in unarmed attacks. If you're an expert in unarmored defense, your eidolon also becomes an expert in unarmored defense. If you have weapon specialization, your eidolon also gains weapon specialization.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Expert Combat Eidolon

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expert Hedge Mage Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits. When you add spells to your keepsake from gaining a spell slot of a new rank from the hedge mage archetype, you can choose 2nd-rank spells. Your keepsake can also hold 2nd-rank spells.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Expert Hedge Mage Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expert Magus Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Basic Magus Spellcasting; master in Arcana
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Expert Magus Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expert Necromancer Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Basic Necromancer Spellcasting; master in Occultism
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Expert Necromancer Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expert Psychic Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Basic Psychic Spellcasting; master in Occultism
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Feat benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Feat benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Expert Psychic Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expert Snowcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You draw ever more magical cold into your being, learning how to manipulate it to your whims.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You draw ever more magical cold into your being, learning how to manipulate it to your whims. You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expert Summoner Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Basic Summoner Spellcasting; master in the skill associated with your eidolon's tradition
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Expert Summoner Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Finessed Features
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've learned how to build snares that trigger based on visual stimuli.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You've learned how to build snares that trigger based on visual stimuli. When you construct a snare using gears, you can cause it to trigger based on the visual features of a creature. For example, you could lay a snare that can only be triggered by a Large or Larger creatures, or one that only activates when a creature wearing red clothing would trigger it. You can use this ability to specify your snares to trigger on creatures that typically do not trigger snares, such as creatures smaller than Small, though the creature must still otherwise satisfy the snare's trigger as normal.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Forewarn
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your foresight and planning are more valuable than armor as you direct your ally away from danger, but there's a limit to how often you can guide your allies away from a foe's relentless assaults.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per minute

**Trigger** An enemy within your overwatch field attempts an attack against an ally who is also within your overwatch field.

Your foresight and planning are more valuable than armor as you direct your ally away from danger, but there's a limit to how often you can guide your allies away from a foe's relentless assaults. The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your ally's AC. Though this allows your ally to avoid taking penalties to their AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to your ally if they are off-guard, even though they wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty when defending against the attack.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Frightful Attrition
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your diminishment of your foes' ranks damages their morale.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your diminishment of your foes' ranks damages their morale. Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a Strike or spell, all enemies within 30 feet of the downed creature who witnessed the attack must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC. A creature that didn't see you directly (such as if you're invisible or remained hidden after the attack) takes a –2 circumstance penalty to this save. Regardless of the result, each creature is temporarily immune to your Frightful Attrition for 10 minutes.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The creature is Frightened 2.

**Critical Failure** The creature is Frightened 3 and fleeing for 1 round.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Great Bear
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: When you transform, you can take on a bear's bulk and size.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

When you transform, you can take on a bear's bulk and size. You can spend an additional action when using Ursine Avenger Form to gain the effects of a 1st-rank Enlarge spell, which lasts for the spell's normal duration or until you leave your Ursine Avenger Form, whichever comes first.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Instigate Psychic Duel
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You attempt to enter a psychic duel with a creature within 100 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You attempt to enter a psychic duel with a creature within 100 feet. The target can attempt a Will save against the higher of your spell DC or class DC. If it enters the duel willingly, use the result for a critical failure.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The two of you enter a psychic duel, but it ends automatically at the end of your next turn. As normal for a psychic duel, the duel ends if one participant is knocked out, as well as under any other conditions to which both participants agree. If you're in initiative when you Instigate the Psychic Duel, you keep the same initiative positions. You can each choose a psychic center for any skill in which you're trained, as you would if you were using that skill to roll initiative for the duel.

**Failure** As a success, except instead of ending at the end of your next turn, the target can attempt a new save to end the duel at the end of each of your turns, starting with your next turn.

**Critical Failure** As a success, except the duel doesn't end until it reaches one of the normal end conditions for a psychic duel.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Instigate Psychic Duel

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Ironclad Fortitude
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Guardian Dedication; expert in Fortitude saves
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Know Thy Doom
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: As your legend grows, details of your demise become clearer.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You are Doomed 1 or greater and your dying value would increase.

As your legend grows, details of your demise become clearer. And you know that it is not yet your time. You can attempt a recovery check using your dying value before it increases, rolling twice and taking the better result. Regardless of the outcome, reduce your doomed value by 1.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Know Thy Doom

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Lesson of Unified Elusion
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You and your student react as one to common threats.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You and your student react as one to common threats. When you and your student are both targeted by the same effect that requires a Reflex saving throw, you and your student take the better of each of your die rolls for the save. You each still add your own Reflex save modifier to the die result.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Lesson of Unified Elusion

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Mass Delusion
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You wave around fabricated evidence that contradicts what your enemies know to be true.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You wave around fabricated evidence that contradicts what your enemies know to be true. When you Fabricate Truth, you can affect all enemies within 30 feet of you. Compare your Deception check result to the Will DCs of all targets. It is possible to get a different degree of success for each target.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Master Spotter
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your incredible perception and trusty enhanced visual gear allow you to see things others miss.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your incredible perception and trusty enhanced visual gear allow you to see things others miss. Your proficiency rank in Perception increases to master.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Metallic Envisionment
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You always account for every weakness, allowing your mind to imagine just the right physical form to take advantage of your opponents.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You always account for every weakness, allowing your mind to imagine just the right physical form to take advantage of your opponents. Choose between cold iron or silver; all your mind weapon Strikes are treated as the chosen type of metal.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Officer's Expertise
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to expert, and you become an expert in Warfare Lore.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to expert, and you become an expert in Warfare Lore. If you're already an expert in Warfare Lore, you instead become an expert in another Lore skill you're trained in or trained in another Lore skill of your choice.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: One-On-One
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your true skill can be seen in a one-on-one fight where you have room to dance around your opponent.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per round

Your true skill can be seen in a one-on-one fight where you have room to dance around your opponent. The Feint attempt must be against the same target as your Strike.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Oneiric Influence
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: While Infiltrating a Dream, you can also implant a suggestion in the target's mind.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
While Infiltrating a Dream, you can also implant a suggestion in the target's mind. The target must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, to resist your modification, which has the effects of a Subconscious Suggestion spell, but even on a critical success, the target doesn't realize you were trying to control them and might not recognize your presence in the dream.

The suggestion remains in the target's subconscious for 1 week or until triggered. Their memories of carrying out the suggestion are hazy and dreamlike, and they might not remember doing it unless later reminded.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Pact of the Final Breath
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've sworn a pact with a powerful psychopomp—typically an olethros advocate or yamaraj judge—granting you a reprieve before your soul will be collected in exchange for respect for the dead and…
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You've sworn a pact with a powerful psychopomp—typically an olethros advocate or yamaraj judge—granting you a reprieve before your soul will be collected in exchange for respect for the dead and assistance against the undead. As long as you keep your end of the bargain, you live twice as long as you normally would before dying of natural causes.

Additionally, the first time each day that you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points and gain the dying condition, you instead regain a number of Hit Points equal to twice your level (starting from 0 HP), remain conscious, and gain fast healing equal to your level for 3 rounds.

Effect: Pact of the Final Breath

In exchange, you swear to treat the dead you come across with respect, performing last rites and final dispositions to ensure their spirits rest in peace and are less likely to rise as undead. Furthermore, you swear to destroy undead you come across, so long as it's within your power to do so without inordinate risk to yourself. Violating your part of the pact causes its protections to immediately end. If at that point you'd already lived beyond your natural lifespan, the psychopomps typically give you a few moments to make any last farewells, and then you simply breathe your final breath and pass on.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Pact of the Final Breath

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Pouncing Transformation
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a land Speed only
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: By transforming as you move, you attack from odd angles.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: By transforming as you move, you attack from odd angles. You Change Shape or Dismiss the change then Stride. Any creature adjacent to you at the end of your movement is off-guard until the end of your turn and is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Pouncing Transformation

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Pupil's Guard
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You're intimately familiar with your student's motions and are ready to step in at a moment's notice should anything threaten to disrupt them.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Trigger** Your student would be targeted with a reaction (such as Reactive Strike) due to their Stride or manipulate action.

**Requirements** You're adjacent to your student.

You're intimately familiar with your student's motions and are ready to step in at a moment's notice should anything threaten to disrupt them. You interpose yourself between the attack and your student, becoming the target of the reaction and taking all damage and associated effects (if any) yourself. This allows your student to complete their action without interruption.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Reach for the Sky
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You command the room, firing a gun into the air and ordering everyone to surrender and put their hands in the air.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You're wielding a loaded firearm.

You command the room, firing a gun into the air and ordering everyone to surrender and put their hands in the air. You fire your firearm and then attempt a single Intimidation check to Demoralize each enemy within 30 feet. Creatures who become frightened instinctively put their hands in the air. If they had Raised a Shield, they lose the benefits, as they raise the shield above their head where it's of little use to block attacks. With their hands in the air, each of these frightened creatures can't use reactions or free actions that require their hands, or items held in their hands, until the beginning of their next turn. Regardless of the result, each creature is then temporarily immune to Reach for the Sky for 1 minute.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Reach for the Sky

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Rearing Display
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've trained your mount to make an impressive attack and can leverage its presence to terrify your enemies.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You are riding your mount.

You've trained your mount to make an impressive attack and can leverage its presence to terrify your enemies. You Command an Animal to order your mount to rear up and make a melee Strike against a creature within its reach. On a successful hit, you can attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize the target. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to this Intimidation check (+2 if the Strike was a critical hit).

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Redirect Spell
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can alter the flow of magic around you, moving a spell effect from one target to another.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You can alter the flow of magic around you, moving a spell effect from one target to another. You gain the Redirect Magic spellshift.

**Spellshift—Redirect Magic** Through sheer force of will, you can direct a spell's energies away from its caster's intended target.

**Critical Success** You change a single target of the spell to another viable target within 30 feet of you (even if it would be outside of the spell's normal range). You can't use this spellshift to affect a creature twice with the same spell. If the spell had an initial saving throw, the new target must attempt it, possibly achieving a different result than the original target of the spell. The DC for the spell becomes your Arcana DC instead of the original caster's spell DC.

**Success** As critical success, but if the target succeeds at any required saving throw, they are unaffected, and the spell does not change targets.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Reflexive Grapple
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've honed your reflexes so well that your lash can begin closing around a target as soon as it makes contact.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You've honed your reflexes so well that your lash can begin closing around a target as soon as it makes contact. Make a lash Strike; if the Strike hits, you can immediately attempt to Grapple the target. Both actions count toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you've made both attacks.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Reflexive Grapple

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Resolute
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've tempered your mind and become resolute against effects that strain your willpower.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You've tempered your mind and become resolute against effects that strain your willpower. Your proficiency rank for Will saves increases to master.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Reverse Curse
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: When you counter a curse or misfortune effect, you send it back to destroy its originator.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: When you counter a curse or misfortune effect, you send it back to destroy its originator. Whenever you succeed at the counteract check to Counter Curse, the creature is affected by its own curse or misfortune effect, attempting a saving throw against its own DC if the effect allows a saving throw. In the case of a constant ability, such as a misfortune aura, the creature is affected only until the beginning of its next turn, when the ability reasserts itself.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Roar Mimicry
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have been targeted by a creature's auditory ability that affects an area or have identified a creature with an auditory ability that affects an area
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You unleash a roar so loud that it's felt as deeply as it's heard.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

You unleash a roar so loud that it's felt as deeply as it's heard. All creatures within a 15-foot emanation take level-based sonic damage and must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. This damage increases by 2d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is Stunned 1. If the creature is adjacent to you, they're also deafened for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is Stunned 2. If the creature is adjacent to you, they're also deafened for 1 minute.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Roar Mimicry

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Runic Expertise
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You become an expert in runesmith class DC.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You become an expert in runesmith class DC.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Second Ikon
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain an additional ikon.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain an additional ikon. When you Spark Transcendence, your spark moves automatically from the ikon you just used to the other ikon.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Second Ikon

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Shared Tide
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a swim Speed
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You Swim up to twice the normal distance.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You Swim up to twice the normal distance. Any ally you pass within 30 feet of during that movement gains your swim Speed until the beginning of your next turn.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Shared Tide

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Shift Horde
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: With a wave of your hand, your risen undead horde collapses and another one rises to take its place.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per round

**Requirements** Your horde is raised.

With a wave of your hand, your risen undead horde collapses and another one rises to take its place. You Sustain your horde, dispersing the current group of undead and replacing them with a different type of undead to which you have access.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Slay
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You finish your target with a vicious attack.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** Your target is Doomed 2 or greater.

You finish your target with a vicious attack. Make a Strike against the target. If you hit, the target takes 4d6 extra precision damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC. If the target critically fails, they die. This is an incapacitation effect. The creature then becomes temporarily immune to your Slay for 1 day.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Smooth Hover
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You remain airborne through sheer effort.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Trigger** You're airborne at the end of your turn.

You remain airborne through sheer effort. You don't fall, even if you didn't use Fly or a similar action this turn.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Smooth Hover

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Space-Time Shift
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You travel just a few moments into the future to immediately arrive at your destination.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** Your turn begins.

You travel just a few moments into the future to immediately arrive at your destination. Your Strides are augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Stride instead of traversing normally to the location. Your augmented Strides have the teleportation trait and don't trigger reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square. You also augment your Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim actions in this way if you have the corresponding movement type.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Spell Acceleration
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Special time-weaving techniques let you compress your spellcasting gestures and incantations into a short burst so you can cast with incredible speed—though it causes temporal strain.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Special time-weaving techniques let you compress your spellcasting gestures and incantations into a short burst so you can cast with incredible speed—though it causes temporal strain. You gain the Quickened Casting feat. It applies to your cantrips and spells from the class you used to qualify for the Time Mage Dedication.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Steal Magic's Breath
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your internal nexus has grown to an immense size and can absorb workings of magic even as they form, sometimes even swallowing them entirely.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You are the target or within the area of a damaging spell or ability with the arcane, divine, magical, occult, or primal trait.

**Requirements** You are not overflowing.

Your internal nexus has grown to an immense size and can absorb workings of magic even as they form, sometimes even swallowing them entirely. You become overflowing as if you had Absorbed Magic. Additionally, you reduce the amount of damage the triggering spell or ability deals by (1d6 per 2 levels) for all creatures targeted by the spell or ability. This reduction is applied before any weaknesses or resistances are taken into account. If you completely mitigate the damage to a creature, the triggering spell or ability has no effect on them.

The amount of damage reduced increases by 1d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Steal Magic's Breath

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Surging Blood Magic
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Rising Blood Magic; master in Arcana or Religion, depending on your chosen tradition
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your blood courses with magic.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your blood courses with magic. You gain the Expert Spellcasting Feat benefits. In addition, when you Cast a Spell from your repertoire and you are at least Drained 2, increase the extra damage dealt by that spell from Rage by an additional 2 (for a total of 3).
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Surging Blood Magic

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: The World Devours
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: The ground in your waking world opens to consume a creature standing on it, which must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** Your waking world is active.

The ground in your waking world opens to consume a creature standing on it, which must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC. The creature must be Medium or smaller; if your waking world is a 20-foot burst, the creature can be Large or smaller, or Huge or smaller if your waking world is a 30-foot burst or larger. If you use this ability while your waking world already has a creature grabbed or devoured, that creature is automatically freed. If your waking world ends, any creature affected by this ability is automatically freed.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage.

**Failure** The creature takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is grabbed by the earth. The creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC.

**Critical Failure** The creature is pulled into the earth, which closes above it. It takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage immediately and is devoured. While devoured, it becomes grabbed and Slowed 1, and takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage at the end of each of its turns, and cannot be targeted by any effect. A creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC; in addition to the normal checks to Escape, it can attempt a Nature check. If it Escapes, it is returned to the area where it was when grabbed. A creature with a burrow Speed can Escape automatically and move up to its burrow Speed as part of that action.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: The World Devours

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Thunderous Landing
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You hurl away enemies with the force of your landing.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You currently have a fly Speed and are airborne.

You hurl away enemies with the force of your landing. You Fly and, if you end your movement on a solid surface, your landing sends out a shock wave of air. Each creature within 10 feet of your landing position must succeed at a Reflex save against your class DC or be pushed 10 feet away. This is forced movement.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Thunderous Landing

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Undying Beast
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can be injured by non-silver sources but recover with staggering speed.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You can be injured by non-silver sources but recover with staggering speed. When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points by non-silver damage and don't immediately die from a death effect or a high dying value, you stabilize immediately afterward. You gain the wounded condition as normal.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Undying Beast

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Wailing Dead
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.traits: archetype, auditory, concentrate, emotion, fear, flourish, magical, mental
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: The voices of the spirits you command spark fear in the hearts of your enemies.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Requirements** Your horde is raised and consists of spirits.

The voices of the spirits you command spark fear in the hearts of your enemies. You Sustain your horde and command those spirits to shriek in unison. Each living enemy within a 20-foot emanation from your horde takes level-based mental damage, depending on its Will saving throw against your spell DC. This damage increases by 1d10 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is Frightened 2.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is Frightened 3.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Ward Slumber
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Just before going to sleep, you can perform a 10-minute ward to protect the slumber of up to eight creatures within 30 feet of you.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Just before going to sleep, you can perform a 10-minute ward to protect the slumber of up to eight creatures within 30 feet of you. All creatures affected by the ritual gain a +4 status bonus on saving throws against Nightmare or other effects influencing dreams (such as those provided by this archetype) until your next daily preparations. They heal double the usual amount of Hit Points from resting.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Wings of the Moon
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a fly Speed
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can stay aloft with Fly normally when using the fly Speed from your animal shape, letting you fly long distances without breaks.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You can stay aloft with Fly normally when using the fly Speed from your animal shape, letting you fly long distances without breaks.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Wings of the Moon

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Awake With a Roar
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.traits: archetype, auditory, emotion, fear, incapacitation, mental, primal
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: When you Rouse the World, it awakens with a mighty yawp that stuns the unsuspecting.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Trigger** You Rouse the World.

When you Rouse the World, it awakens with a mighty yawp that stuns the unsuspecting. All enemies in the area must attempt a Will save against your world rouser DC. A creature that attempts this save or observes this ability becomes temporarily immune to it for 24 hours.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The creature becomes Frightened 2 and Stunned 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature becomes Frightened 3 and stunned 1.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Awake With a Roar

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Bombing Run
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Using your elevation and speed to your advantage, you deliver aerial payloads with greater force.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You currently have a fly Speed.

Using your elevation and speed to your advantage, you deliver aerial payloads with greater force. You Fly and can Interact to draw a bomb. At any point during your movement, you can also make a Strike with an alchemical bomb. The bomb deals its splash damage to every creature within 10 feet of the target.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Bombing Run

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Borrow Memories
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Knowing how someone thinks makes it much easier to know where they'll be, or even replace them altogether.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Knowing how someone thinks makes it much easier to know where they'll be, or even replace them altogether. You can cast Mind Probe as an innate occult spell once per day, using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

If you cast *mind probe* on a target you're studying for the purpose of Assuming their Role, and the target fails their save, you can delay the spell from coming into effect until you Assume their Role. When you use the spell this way, you can Sustain it up to 10 times during its duration, asking a question each time. The spell lasts until you ask all 10 questions or are no longer Assuming the Role, whichever comes first. You don't need to Sustain the Spell to extend its duration-only when asking a question-nor do you need to be in range or have line of effect to Sustain it.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Community Needs
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You have learned to take the time needed to be flexible and to contemplate the best use of your magic for those around you.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You have learned to take the time needed to be flexible and to contemplate the best use of your magic for those around you. You can spend 10 minutes to empty one of your prepared spell slots and prepare a different spell from your keepsake in its place. If you're interrupted during such a swap, the original spell remains prepared and can still be cast. You can try again to swap out the spell later, but you must start the process over again.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Concentrated Assault
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You and your spotter combine your efforts to bring down your target.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You and your spotter combine your efforts to bring down your target. If you and your spotter both use the Ready activity to make a Strike against the same opponent and choose the same trigger for the readied action, resolve your attacks at the same time. Each of you can use the higher of the two attack rolls for your Strikes, each using your own modifier; this is a fortune effect. If both attacks are successful, total the damage for both attacks for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Control Tower
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your keen senses and ability to process battlefield information have dramatically improved, allowing you to drastically reduce the advantage of unseen foes.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your keen senses and ability to process battlefield information have dramatically improved, allowing you to drastically reduce the advantage of unseen foes. You and allies in your overwatch field gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using the Seek action to find hidden or undetected creatures within the overwatch field.

Effect: Control Tower

You and your allies don't have to succeed at a flat check to target a concealed creature within your overwatch field. When you or an ally targets a hidden creature in your overwatch field, reduce the DC of the flat check to 5.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Cratering Drop
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You follow up your enemy's fall, driving you both to the earth in a meteoric descent.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** Your previous action was Pluck from the Sky using a melee Strike, and the target failed or critically failed its saving throw.

You follow up your enemy's fall, driving you both to the earth in a meteoric descent. You Fly straight down, increasing the amount the enemy falls by your Fly speed. If you reach the ground, you drive the enemy into the ground, dealing double the normal falling damage.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Cratering Drop

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Death Rattle
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: When the time comes for your horde to be returned to its temporary rest, its departure carries those nearby closer to death.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** Your horde is raised.

When the time comes for your horde to be returned to its temporary rest, its departure carries those nearby closer to death. Dismiss your raised horde, which draws life energy toward it as it crumbles to the ground and fades away. Each living creature within your horde's space or in a 5-foot emanation around it must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC or become Drained 1 (Drained 2 on a critical failure).

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Devastating Manifestation
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your armaments are especially powerful the moment after you manifest them.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** At least one of your soulforged armaments is not manifested.

Your armaments are especially powerful the moment after you manifest them. You Manifest Soulforged Armament. If you manifested a weapon, make up to two Strikes with that weapon, each targeting a different creature and each dealing an additional 1d6 spirit damage. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but your penalty doesn't increase until you have made all your attacks. If you Manifested an armor or shield, you gain resistance 5 to all damage until the start of your next turn. If you manifested both a weapon and an armor or shield, you gain both effects.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Dream Logic
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can transmit a sense of dreamy nonchalance.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You can transmit a sense of dreamy nonchalance. If you do something especially strange or dangerous while you're in your Daydream Trance, such as entering a restricted area or fighting someone in the street, any creature that isn't one of your allies must attempt a Perception check against your class or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a success, it realizes something is amiss, and on a failure, it believes nothing is out of the ordinary. The creature can attempt a new check if you start doing something else strange, but not if you continue on the same course of action it already failed to notice was peculiar.

Any hostile action by you or your allies against an affected creature automatically ends the effect for that creature. The GM might allow the creature a new check if someone else brings your actions to its attention, such as if someone you're attacking calls out for help. When your trance ends, affected creatures retain their memories of events but likely still view them as unremarkable; unless they're prompted to relate the events, they might not report them.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Effortless Captivation
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You maintain your innate charms and illusions with hardly a thought.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Trigger** Your turn begins.

You maintain your innate charms and illusions with hardly a thought. You Sustain an innate captivator spell.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Exceptional Follower
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your followers' abilities have soared to new heights.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your followers' abilities have soared to new heights. All your followers become exceptional followers.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Expanded Swarm
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your hive has grown to the point where it is difficult to keep your swarm contained within your body.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your hive has grown to the point where it is difficult to keep your swarm contained within your body. When you release your swarm with Swarm Forth, you can choose for it to be Huge instead of Large.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Expanded Swarm

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Hush
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You strike a target and hinder their attempts to call for help.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You are veiled.

You strike a target and hinder their attempts to call for help. You teleport to a square within 60 feet and make a Strike against a creature; if you hit, it must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target is then immune to your Hush for 24 hours.

**Success** The target is otherwise unaffected.

**Failure** The target takes 10d6 force damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target takes 15d6 untyped damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 minute.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: In the Horde's Grip
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: When your skeletons and zombies attack, their skeletal claws and rotting hands clutch and tear flesh.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: When your skeletons and zombies attack, their skeletal claws and rotting hands clutch and tear flesh. Weaker foes are caught in their grip. You command your horde to perform a Mobbing Assault. Instead of being off-guard, a creature who takes physical damage from failing the saving throw is grabbed by your horde (restrained on a critical failure). The DC to Escape from your horde is equal to your spell DC. Creatures grabbed by your horde that fail a saving throw against the horde's Mobbing Assault take 2d6 persistent bleed damage.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: In the Horde's Grip

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Lesson of the Hurricane's Might
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You and your student enact a graceful dance of battle.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You and your student enact a graceful dance of battle. When you use Lesson of the Circling Gale, you can Strike as a free action after you Step. Your multiple attack penalty applies to this Strike as normal. Your student can Strike after they Step as part of their reaction. This Strike doesn't count toward your student's multiple attack penalty, and their multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Lesson of the Hurricane's Might

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Lonely Army
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You move and attack with deadly silence, unbelievable speed, and unlimited ferocity.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You are in your favored location; you are currently hidden, unobserved, or unnoticed by all enemies; and you are not fatigued.

You move and attack with deadly silence, unbelievable speed, and unlimited ferocity. Strike with a blowgun or sling; if the Strike is successful, the enemy cannot tell where it came from and you remain hidden. Immediately after the successful Strike, you can Sneak to a new location, Interact to reload a blowgun or sling, and Strike again, remaining hidden on a successful Strike. If the second Strike is successful, you can Sneak, Interact to reload, and then Strike with a sling or blowgun a third time, remaining hidden after a successful Strike.

After using Lonely Army, you are fatigued for 1 minute.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Only My Doom May Claim Me
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: The power of your legend, fueled by your legendary deeds, resists any weapon that is not tied to your curse.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: The power of your legend, fueled by your legendary deeds, resists any weapon that is not tied to your curse. You gain resistance equal to half your level against weapon and unarmed attacks that deal a damage type other than the type chosen for your cursed weakness.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Only My Doom May Claim Me

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Pact of Eldritch Eyes
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've sworn a pact with an entity beyond mortal comprehension, granting you distant visions.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You've sworn a pact with an entity beyond mortal comprehension, granting you distant visions. You can cast Scouting Eye as an occult innate spell once per hour, using the higher of your class DC and your spell DC to determine the DC.

In exchange, you allow the entity to peer through you at your world. The entity's touch creates strange dreams, typically nightmares. Every morning, you awaken trained in an unexpected Lore skill determined by the GM, which you retain until the next time you rest for the night. While the entity contacts you most often while you sleep, it occasionally peers at you during the day, leading to disorientation and visions. You can generally determine what's going on during these visions, so normally this occurrence imparts no mechanical penalty. However, in the unlikely event that an encounter begins while you're experiencing visions from the entity, you might take a circumstance penalty to your initiative roll.

**Special** The entity isn't particularly attached to its pact with you. If you want it gone, you can retrain out of Pact of Eldritch Eyes, after which the entity withdraws its eyes to the void.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Pact of Eldritch Eyes

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Phase Bullet
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can aim your bullets not just in three normal dimensions, but in additional dimensions as well, removing all obstacles between you and your target.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You can aim your bullets not just in three normal dimensions, but in additional dimensions as well, removing all obstacles between you and your target. Attempt a crossbow or firearm Strike against a foe who's observed or hidden to you (but not undetected). The ammunition travels to your target in a straight line, passing through any non-magical barriers or walls in its way, though magical barriers and force effects stop the bullet. The shot ignores all cover, the concealed condition, the hidden condition, and circumstance bonuses to AC from shields. It has a +4 status bonus to hit creatures wearing any type of armor. The Strike's damage can't be reduced with a Shield Block reaction using a non-magical shield.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Pounce Mimicry
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use an ability that lets them Stride and Strike as a single action (such as Pounce) or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You have mastered the art of stalking your prey and striking when they are most vulnerable.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You're unarmored or wearing light armor.

You have mastered the art of stalking your prey and striking when they are most vulnerable. You Stride and then Strike. If you began this action hidden, you remain hidden until after the Strike. You can use Pounce Mimicry while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Pounce Mimicry

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Precise Hooks
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your body is a varied and deadly weapon.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your body is a varied and deadly weapon. When you critically hit a target with your claw or talon, you can apply a critical specialization effect based on the stance you're in. For claw stance, apply the knife weapon group's effect. For talon stance, apply the axe group's effect. These effects are in addition to the claw's or talon's normal critical specialization effect if you apply it.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Precise Hooks

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Quick Absorption
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: After so much exposure to the myriad forms of magical energy, you absorb magic almost instinctively.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: After so much exposure to the myriad forms of magical energy, you absorb magic almost instinctively. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that can only be used to Absorb Magic.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Ranged Disarm
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: When using a simple firearm, you can shoot objects right out of your enemy's hands.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You're wielding a simple firearm or simple combination weapon.

When using a simple firearm, you can shoot objects right out of your enemy's hands. Attempt to Disarm the target using a ranged attack roll with the required firearm or combination weapon, instead of attempting an Athletics check against the target's Reflex DC.

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Rapid Hybridization
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: When danger threatens, your instincts kick in, and you can assume a different shape at a moment's notice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Trigger** You roll initiative.

When danger threatens, your instincts kick in, and you can assume a different shape at a moment's notice. You use Change Shape to enter your hybrid shape.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Rapid Hybridization

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Reset the Past
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You manipulate time to recharge one of your temporal techniques—by revising your past so you never used it in the first place.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You manipulate time to recharge one of your temporal techniques—by revising your past so you never used it in the first place. Select one of your chronoskimmer feats that has a frequency of once per day (or more frequent) that you've already used. You can use the feat again, as if you hadn't used it already.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Reset the Past

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Scarred Hide
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your hide is an impenetrable mass of scars, accrued over countless bloody conflicts.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your hide is an impenetrable mass of scars, accrued over countless bloody conflicts. When in your hybrid or animal shape, you gain resistance to non-silver slashing damage equal to half your level.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Scarred Hide

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Simultaneous Strike
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Moving in unison, you and your student unleash an attack against a foe.
